content.title: Crypto's CLARITY Act markup delayed: It's a 'significant' setback
content.description:
The Senate has delayed its markup of the CLARITY Act, which would have been a critical step for the landmark crypto legislation. The delay is a notable setback for investors' hopes of seeing crypto regulation this year.

Additionally, Coinbase (COIN) CEO Brian Armstrong withdrew his support of the bill in its current form, noting that it would be worse than no bill at all.

Bitwise Asset Management chief investment officer Matt Hougan sits down with Opening Bid host Brian Sozzi to discuss the latest crypto headlines and how these setbacks impact the industry as a whole.

Bitwise operates several of its own bitcoin (BITB, BITC, BTOP) and crypto (BITQ, BITW) exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

content.title: Bitcoin, gold, AI were key drivers of 2025's record ETF inflows
content.description:
Net inflows into exchange-traded funds (ETFs) totaled a record $1.03 trillion last year, and they're already set to break that record this year, currently sitting at $1.28 trillion year to date.

Amplify ETFs CEO, Christian Magoon, joins Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to explain where money was going in 2025 and what ETF trends he anticipates next year.

content.title: Bitcoin Isn’t Just a Tech Stock on Steroids. What Really Moves It.
content.summary: Since the launch of spot Bitcoin ETFs in early 2024, investors have been haunted by a persistent narrative: “Bitcoin is just a tech stock on steroids.”  The common view is that when the stock market sneezes, Bitcoin catches a cold.  Moderate correlations of +0.3 to +0.7 mean that a relationship exists, but the assets often diverge.

content.title: Crypto: A 'trap door' will open up if bitcoin falls below $80K
content.description:
While bitcoin (BTC-USD) bounces back above $88,000 per token on Tuesday, a lot of damage has already been done in the broader crypto space as the asset's extended sell-off has dragged crypto stocks and ETFs lower.

Sevens Report Research Founder Tom Essaye and Yahoo Finance senior reporters Brooke DiPalma and Ines Ferré weigh in on the state of the crypto space, coming as Bank of America is recommending that its wealth management clients should allocate 4% of their portfolios into crypto.
